# superset_tag (Resource)

Manages a tag, a label attached to charts, dashboards and saved queries with the `TAGGING_SYSTEM` feature flag. The objects a tag is attached to are managed by the `tags` of `superset_chart` and `superset_dashboard`; the tag keeps them when it is renamed, and is detached from them when it is destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_tag" "finance" {
  name        = "finance"
  description = "Owned by the finance team"
}

# The tags of a chart or a dashboard are set on the object; a tag that does not exist yet is created.
resource "superset_chart" "revenue" {
  name          = "Revenue"
  datasource_id = superset_dataset.sales.id
  viz_type      = "table"
  params        = jsonencode({ viz_type = "table", all_columns = ["day", "amount"] })
  tags          = [superset_tag.finance.name, "weekly-review"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tag, unique in Superset.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description of the tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the tag.
